name: maestro-of-cerebellums
description: One chat that routes to your local Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Kimi, and Zai (GLM) CLIs. Unofficial multi-model orchestrator.

chatParticipants.name: maestro
chatParticipants.description: One agent that routes across Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Kimi, and Zai (GLM)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Maestro of Cerebellums
walkthroughs.description: One agent chat. Local CLIs do the work behind it.

steps.title: Open the Maestro chat
steps.description:
Talk to one agent. Maestro routes each request to Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Kimi, or Zai.
[Open Maestro Chat](command:maestro.openChat)

steps.title: Choose Ask / Agent and Auto / Fast / Ultra
steps.description:
Stay on Ask + Auto until you want file edits or a multi-model draft.
[How it works](command:maestro.howItWorks)

steps.title: Confirm your CLIs
steps.description:
Maestro only uses CLIs that are installed and already logged in.
[Run Doctor](command:maestro.doctor)

maestro.port.description: Port of the local Maestro sidecar (OpenAI-compatible API).
